text:
olivia (FinOps): Heads-up  launching price-sheet v3 A/B next week. New ask: we discovered a set of vendor credits (GPU promo + partner accelerator) that were historically passed through and appear as negative line items. Need a rule so experiment metrics ignore those or treat them separately. Also finance wants an approval stamp from legal for retro credits policy.

aj (Billing): Good catch. I can add a vendor-credit exclusion filter keyed by SKU pattern and vendor_id. Will add a `vendor_pass_through` boolean to invoice line parsing so metrics can split gross vs net.

kevin (Revenue Ops): I'll compile the known vendor SKU list and post to the drive. Proposal: exclude negative line items with `vendor_id` in {cloud-accel, partner-x} OR SKU prefix `VEND-`.

lena (Sales Ops): FYI some enterprise accounts have negotiated credits recorded as negative subscriptions (not vendor SKUs). Those must NOT be excluded. How do we distinguish?

aj (Billing): Good flag. We'll only exclude line items where `line_type == "vendor_credit"` and `vendor_id` not null. Anything recorded as `account_credit` or `contractual_discount` stays in the experiment.

nora (Support): If we split gross/net on invoices, support macros should call out which view customers are seeing. I'll draft messaging accordingly.

matt (Legal): For retro credits: legal prefers manual review for credits > $200 per account. For <= $200 we can auto-approve refunds/credits but need an audit CSV. Also want language for customer notifications.

olivia (FinOps): OK timeline: we need vendor exclusion implemented and the audit CSV by Friday EOD so DS can run pre/post metrics. Can everyone make that?

aj (Billing): I can implement vendor_pass_through flag and exclusion logic by Thursday. Will add a unit test and a migration to tag historical lines.

kevin (Revenue Ops): I'll deliver vendor SKU list + drive link by Wednesday noon.

lena (Sales Ops): I'll flag negotiated contract credits in the cohort CSV so billing won't mis-classify.

matt (Legal): I'll draft the retro-credit policy snippet and post for sign-off by Thursday. Keep the auto-approve threshold at $200 sounds fine.

ops-bot: Note: please attach runbook section `billing/credits-exclude.md` to the experiment doc.

olivia (FinOps): One more: can we add a short manual reconciliation flow for accounts with non-vendor negative lines that show >10% delta? Want to avoid erroneous charge reversals.

aj (Billing): Yes  we'll open `#billing-reconciliations` tickets for any account where non-vendor negative lines cause >10% revenue delta. Triage will be manual.

kevin (Revenue Ops): I'll add monitoring: metric `experiment.vendor_credit_coverage` and alert if >5% of cohort invoices have ambiguous negative lines.

olivia (FinOps): Great. Final deliverables: vendor-SKU list (kevin), code + tests (aj), legal policy (matt), cohort flags (lena), support macros (nora). Friday EOD go/no-go check in this thread.

nora (Support): I'll prep macros + KB and link here before EOD Friday.

aj (Billing): PR will be `tools/billing/vendor_credit_tagging.py`. Posting staging run results here when ready.

olivia (FinOps): thanks team. If anything blocks the vendor-SKU list or legal approval, call it out now. ops-bot: tag this thread as `pricing-experiment` and `vendor-credits`.
